input.missingFootageAction: Ask for the current speaker footage; do not request an LP or fabricate a new speaker script.

durationPolicy: Preserve meaningful speech and its order; remove only justified Japanese fillers and unnecessary pauses. New duration and caption count come from the cleaned current speech, not the87.966667second61caption reference.

helperCompatibility.reason: A04 requires current ChatCut Script cleanup, then independent overlays on the resulting live timing. Legacy helpers link fixed pattern cues and cuts and must reject this route.

speechWorkflow.japaneseFillerDecision: Listen to context; preserve meaningful hesitation, agreement, emotion and replies. Do not delete only by a word match.
speechWorkflow.scriptOperations: Read, revise and apply Script through the tools currently available in the connected ChatCut environment. Preserve live revisions and use actual word/silence timestamps.
speechWorkflow.captionTimingSource: actual cleaned timeline after Script edits; never pre-cleanup draft timing or estimated character-count timing

audio.addSfx: Use short similar emphasis/closing sounds where corresponding moments exist in the current speech.

sfxPolicy.ifNoUsableSound: Report SFX not added; do not claim original sound reproduced. Continue the speech/caption edit.
sfxPolicy.timing: Place at the current selected emphasis entrance or actual closing statement after speech cleanup, not at reference timestamps.
sfxPolicy.gain: Original CapCut volumes are starting references only. Confirm current tool volume units and listen; adjust to keep speech intelligible.
sfxPolicy.frequency: Sparse emphasis and closing punctuation; do not add sound to every caption or invent a closing CTA.

captionPolicy.closingSelection: Style an actual closing statement if present. Do not add reservation wording or CTA absent from the new footage or user instruction.

editingAndCorrection.textOnlyRevision: Update the caption layer text, line boxes and glyphs while preserving cleaned video/voice timing. Do not delete Script words to fix a subtitle typo.

editingAndCorrection.nativeOrMgTextEditLimitation: If glyph outlines are used, text edits may require Codex to regenerate glyphs/layout rather than a simple text-field change.

requiredPerJob: Listen around every removed filler/pause; protect word beginnings/endings and lip sync.
Check all caption changes,1/2line box shapes, long names, red entrance, beginning/end and text clipping in actual composites.

Watch the complete finished timeline and actual exported MP4 when requested.
verification.report: Distinguish source analysis, implemented settings, checked composite frames, audible checks and saved MP4. Do not describe a metadata-only template as a verified new video.
